verdict: MATERIAL DEFECT CONFIRMED — a failed first attempt can be followed by a SECOND source operation while the retries account stays 0
law: all seven frozen plans carry max_retry_budget = 0; the successor's retry_stop_law states 'Retries must be separately counted and reason-coded; retry may not change source, encoding, variables, operations, or authority' and the frozen maximum is ZERO retries across all sources

decisive_experiment.method: PUBLIC BoundSourceExecution.execute() called twice on one bound execution; the source file was transiently unavailable for attempt 1 and restored before attempt 2
decisive_experiment.conclusion: TWO source operations occurred (2 existence checks, 2 decoder entries) under one bound execution whose frozen retry budget is 0, and the `retries` account remained 0 throughout

why_the_gate_does_not_stop_it.mechanism: _gate_route_pass() tests RoutePassSpec.admits(self._passes_completed). Because the increment happens only AFTER a successful session.run(), a FAILED attempt leaves _passes_completed at 0, so the gate admits a retry.
why_the_gate_does_not_stop_it.consequence: the outer route-pass gate is the only pre-operation gate in the wrapper, and it keys on COMPLETED passes, not on attempts or retries — so it cannot implement a retry ceiling

also_confirmed.repeatable_multi_attempt: with a permanently mismatched expected_sha256, three consecutive execute() calls each performed the pre-pass source operations (existence + hash) and each failed with SOURCE_SHA256_MISMATCH; retries stayed 0 and no pre-operation refusal occurred
also_confirmed.postcondition_failure_case: when the failure occurs AFTER the increment (post-operation constraint), the increment has already happened, so a second execute() is refused by ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED — but that is the route-pass ceiling firing, not a retry gate

separate_quantities_required.route_pass_attempts: not modelled at all — _pass_attempted is a boolean, not an account, and is never exposed in the receipt
separate_quantities_required.retries: present as an account/budget field but NEVER incremented by the binding layer and never gated; observed 0 in every failing-retry experiment
separate_quantities_required.verdict: the three quantities are NOT kept distinct; only the third exists

required_repair: add a pre-operation RETRY gate keyed on a retry/attempt account, distinct from the route-pass account
count attempts separately from completed passes
increment and expose `retries` (reason-coded) so a second attempt under max 0 is refused BEFORE any source operation
ensure the refusal leaves every lower-layer account unchanged, as the existing route-pass gate correctly does

existing_court_coverage_gap.gap_1: it calls ex.session.run(...) DIRECTLY, bypassing the public BoundSourceExecution.execute() wrapper, so it never exercises the retry path the commission asked about
existing_court_coverage_gap.gap_2: it stops at asserting spec.route_pass.admits(ex._passes_completed) is True — i.e. it positively asserts that a retry WOULD be admitted, without ever testing whether a second execute() then performs a second source operation
existing_court_coverage_gap.consequence: the court passes while the underlying retry defect is live
